# rdv-status

[中文手册](../../../docs/zh/actions/rdv-status.md) · [English guide](../../../docs/en/actions/rdv-status.md)

把测试开始与最终结果写回 AtomGit PR：维护 RDV-RUNNING、RDV-SUCC、RDV-FAIL 标签，并发布带工作流链接的评论。

Reports test start and completion on a AtomGit PR by maintaining RDV-RUNNING, RDV-SUCC and RDV-FAIL labels and posting comments with workflow links.
